name: check-list
title: Check list
description: A list with a check or a dash on each line: what is included and what is not, said in words for screen readers, with hints and tooltips for plan cards and requirements.
docs: Every line carries a hidden "Included" or "Not included". tone="inverted" is for a card with a solid fill: the focus ring and the tooltip swap colours there, so both still show on the card. A line with a tooltip gets a small info button that opens on hover, focus and tap; without tooltips the list is a Server Component.
